$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: FESN Carteirinha

extraction.evidence: The app ships a Tailwind v4 + shadcn stylesheet whose :root block is emitted TWICE: first an sRGB hex block, then a lab() progressive-enhancement block. The hex block is the authored ground truth and is cited directly. Every non-:root value (brand palette, type ramp, layout rhythm) was read from getComputedStyle() in headless Chromium at 1440/768/390 and converted to sRGB through a 1x1 canvas readback, because Chromium re-serializes lab()/oklab() rather than returning rgb().
extraction.note: Only slots with a real or derived value are listed. The emitter fills unspecified A2 slots from the OpenDesign schema fallback and B-slots from their aliasTo sibling. Light-only: the target has NO dark theme — adding .dark to <html> changes nothing on any route, and the stylesheet contains no `.dark { --background: ... }` override block.

--bg.reason: --background: the app canvas. Both page shells paint a subtle gradient on top of it (from-slate-50 via-white to-slate-100/70); white is the declared base.

--surface.reason: --card: every lifted container (consulta card, benefit cards, FAQ shell, hero side card)

--surface-warm.reason: blue-50: the tertiary informational surface — hero 'Benefício financeiro recorrente' box and the CTA band gradient tail

--fg.reason: slate-900: <main class='… text-slate-900'> page ink and every h1/h2 on /vendas

--fg-2.reason: slate-700: lead paragraphs and long-form body copy

--muted.reason: slate-600: card descriptions in the benefit and step grids
--muted.source: computed: benefit card p color on /vendas

--meta.reason: slate-500: helper text under the CPF input and the footnote on /

--border.reason: slate-200: the visible card edge used by every surface on / and /vendas

--border-soft.reason: --border/--input: the quieter shadcn hairline on the input, buttons and FAQ row separators

--accent.reason: blue-700: the only chromatic emphasis color — 'PASSO 1/2/3' eyebrows, inline links, section icons

--accent-on.reason: no filled-accent surface exists on the target; white is the only readable pairing against #1447e6 (contrast 6.9:1)

--accent-hover.reason: blue-800: the deeper accent tier, used as the hero badge label on blue-100
--accent-hover.source: computed: span.text-blue-800 ('Emissão oficial FESN') color on /vendas

--accent-active.reason: one step below --accent-hover; the target never renders a pressed accent state

--success.reason: green-600: the '✓' glyph on the Certificado pill

--warn.reason: amber-600: the highlighted savings clause in the hero lead paragraph

--danger.reason: --destructive (red-600). Declared in :root but never rendered — the target surfaces failure as a full not-found page, not as inline error styling.

--font-display.reason: --font-geist-sans, applied to every heading. NOTE: the target declares Geist but never loads it — 0 font requests, 0 @font-face rules, document.fonts.size === 0 — so it renders as Segoe UI / Helvetica Neue in practice. Stack reproduced verbatim.

--font-body.reason: same stack for body copy — the target has one family for display and text

--font-mono.value: "Geist Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
--font-mono.reason: --font-geist-mono: declared, not exercised by any rendered element

--text-xs.reason: text-xs: 'PASSO N' eyebrow, input helper text, footer legal lines

--text-sm.reason: text-sm: buttons, labels, card body copy, footer links

--text-base.reason: text-base: long-form body copy and FAQ triggers
